---
title: "Tutorial"
lang: en-US
---

- [Getting started](getting-started.qmd) — using paragraphs from *Frankenstein*: dense
  vector search with LSI-derived embeddings, full-text search with BM25 and TF-IDF, plus
  soft-delete, filtering, calibrating for a target recall, close/reopen, and the
  whole-dataset operations (`allknn`, `fft`, `closestpairs`, `bichromatic_kclosestpairs`).

- [Paragraph search over books and Wikipedia](paragraph-search.qmd) — the larger tour: four
  real corpora (100 Gutenberg books each in English, Spanish and Portuguese, plus 1000
  Wikipedia articles), all retrieved by paragraph, each indexed against a `TextProfile` fitted
  for it. Covers fitting and loading profiles, what `install`/`list`/`info` do, correcting a
  query against the vocabulary, expanding it through the profile's network, and what building
  the whole thing actually cost.
